inputs.image_url: the gated lip-sync close-up (picture_gate PASS or ACCEPT_WITH_FLAG receipt for these exact bytes; upload_measured URL)
inputs.audio_url: the on-screen speaker's own line cut from the LEAD-VOCAL STEM (separate-vocals), never the mix

sentences: A {who_descriptor} {character_noun} {verb} this line to the camera with a {emotion} expression.
Minimal head movement{head_extra}, steady locked camera, natural blinks, relaxed shoulders, {framing}.
{Poss} whole face and mouth stay fully visible, with no text, captions or watermark.

slots.who_descriptor: from the look's mode: modes/*.json kling_who (e.g. '3D animated', 'photoreal', 'hand-painted 2D animated')
slots.character_noun: plain noun from the cast record: woman, man, girl, boy, older woman, older man
slots.verb: 'sings' when the line's delivery is sung (singcheck >= 0.8), 'says' when spoken; rap lines use 'raps'
slots.emotion: ONE emotion word from the shot's planned visible_emotion (scene_match); pain lines never get a smile word; no comma-joined pairs
slots.head_extra: optional, at most one: ', a small nod on the strong beat' | ', a slight head tilt' | '' (default)
slots.framing: 'chest-up framing, eyes to the lens' (default) | 'medium close-up, eyes to the lens'
slots.Poss: His | Her | Their, from the cast record

prompt_template.hard_max_status: UNVERIFIED for the KIE wrapper; guard anyway
prompt_template.note: Three sentences. Today's lip_gate._PROMPT has four (the closing 'No text, captions or watermark.' is its own sentence) and pairs two emotion words ('calm, earnest'); file 17 asks for 1-3 sentences and one main emotion.

forbidden: the spoken or sung words themselves (no quoted text, no 4-word run from the line's lyric)
any instruction that drives the mouth: 'lips open and close', 'in time with', 'every syllable', 'mouths the words'
camera moves other than 'steady locked camera'
hands near the face, microphones, props at the mouth
'3D animated' on a look whose mode is realism or painted (who_descriptor must come from the mode)

image_rules.framing: chest-up 9:16, face about 30-40% of frame height, head centred, eyes to lens, shoulders square
image_rules.mouth: lips relaxed and very slightly parted, calm neutral expression, no teeth showing
image_rules.light: soft even light across the whole face, no hard shadow on the mouth, plain background separated from the head
image_rules.gate: picture_gate constants (one rule set): FAIL face count != 1, face height < 20%, |roll| > 20, |yaw| > 0.25, jawOpen > 0.30, sharpness < 60; FLAG smile > 0.60, lip gap > 1.0%, face < 25%, |roll| > 5, |yaw| > 0.12, jawOpen > 0.15, sharpness < 100; at least 720x1280, 9:16

audio_rules.source: lead-vocal stem only (Suno separate-vocals), never the mix, never a narrator or another character
audio_rules.cut: lipsync_clips.choose_window: starts at a word start, ends at a word end, 0.30 s pre-roll and 0.20 s tail from try 1; stem_offset.cut_plan corrects stem lateness
audio_rules.length: 4-6 s per clip, no clip over 6 s
audio_rules.cleanliness: no reverb tail across the cut (end at the word end + 0.20 s); pad with digital silence if the stem carries bleed; mono wav or 320 kbps mp3, 44.1 or 48 kHz
audio_rules.window_preference: >= 1.5 word onsets per second, no held word over 1.2 s (else HELD_NOTE), prefer p/b/m/f/v/w words, a different hook line per clip when the hook repeats

tries: At most 2 paid jobs per segment, every name variant counted (lipsync_clips.check_try_limit / LipTryLimit). Try 2 only on a PERSON's defect call and only with a CHANGED input. Then KEPT_BEST_OF_2. No third job, no model switch.
